mapper.select: SELECT C.COMMENT_ID, C.USER_ID, C.POST_ID, C.PARENT_COMMENT_ID, C.CONTENT, C.IS_DELETED, C.CREATE_AT, C.UPDATE_AT, U.NICKNAME, ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM COMMENT_LIKE CL WHERE CL.COMMENT_ID = C.COMMENT_ID ) AS LIKE_COUNT, EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM COMMENT_LIKE CL WHERE CL.COMMENT_ID = C.COMMENT_ID AND CL.USER_ID = #{loginUserId} ) AS LIKED FROM `COMMENT` C JOIN `USER` U ON C.USER_ID = U.ID WHERE C.POST_ID = #{postId} ORDER BY COALESCE(C.PARENT_COMMENT_ID, C.COMMENT_ID) ASC, CASE WHEN C.PARENT_COMMENT_ID IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END ASC, C.COMMENT_ID ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO `COMMENT` ( USER_ID, POST_ID, PARENT_COMMENT_ID, CONTENT, CREATE_AT, UPDATE_AT ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{postId}, #{parentCommentId}, #{content}, NOW(), NOW() )
mapper.update: UPDATE `COMMENT` SET CONTENT = '삭제된 댓글입니다.', IS_DELETED = TRUE, UPDATE_AT = NOW() WHERE COMMENT_ID = #{commentId} AND USER_ID = #{userId} AND IS_DELETED = FALSE
